articles.title: How sensitive data from Centrelink and other Australian agencies may have been fed to Palantir software
articles.summary: Exclusive: Personal information of Centrelink clients and childcare workers is among data shared with ACIC, which uses US tech company’s software. The personal information of Centrelink customers, taxpayers and childcare workers is among a trove of sensitive data that may be ending up in Palantir’s…
body: As Guardian Australia reported in September, Palantir’s software is used by the Australian Criminal Intelligence Commission (ACIC) as part of the multi-agency fraud fusion taskforce, which was established in 2022 with the goal of targeting fraud in government payments from the national disability insurance scheme, childcare and welfare.

New documents, released under freedom of information requests, reveal the extent to which at least 10 government agencies share sensitive data with the taskforce, which could be fed into Palantir’s software.

The controversial US tech company, co-founded by the Donald Trump-aligned billionaire Peter Thiel, has clients including the Israeli military and US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) that use the software to analyse vast amounts of data.

While the company has insisted it has no access to the data clients enter into the software, the Greens leader, David Shoebridge, has led calls for a ban on Palantir contracts with the Australian government.

articles.title: F.D.A. Rejects Closely Watched Lung Cancer Drug From China
articles.summary: This X-ray shows stage 1 cancer. Summit Therapeutics of Florida had been seeking to bring to the U.S. market a drug for lung cancer, called ivonescimab, that was invented in China.
body: The Food and Drug Administration rejected a first-of-its-kind cancer drug that was invented in China, a setback for a medicine that had become a symbol of China’s ascendance as a powerhouse in drug development.

Summit Therapeutics, the Florida company that has been seeking to bring the drug to the American market, disclosed the agency’s decision in a news release on Sunday. Summit bought the U.S. rights to the drug from Akeso Biopharma, a Chinese drugmaker that invented the drug in its laboratories and sells it in China.

Summit had been seeking approval only for certain patients with advanced lung cancer. But the drug had raised high hopes because it is being tested in many more cancers, including tumors of the colon, bladder and breast.

Summit said on Sunday that the F.D.A. told the company it had rejected the drug because it had not shown a statistically significant benefit in prolonging patients’ lives in the global clinical trial that was the basis of Summit’s application.

articles.title: Kindness of strangers: I was stranded, dressed as a flapper, on a freezing night. Then a cheerful taxi driver pulled over
articles.summary: My tyre was blown so he changed it for me. When I offered payment he said, ‘Don’t be ridiculous, love’ I had to fight not to lose control of the car. I was in my early 20s and driving home from a fancy dress party when bang – my tyre suddenly blew.
body: It was 1982 in Canberra; a foggy, bitterly cold night in the middle of winter. I was wearing a silly flapper dress and high heels – I’m not sure I’d even packed a jacket! I had a spare tyre in the back but little idea how to change it. My options were to make the one-hour walk home alone or wait to see if another car passed and could offer me a ride. For 30 minutes I sat in the driver’s seat helplessly, unsure what to do.

The roads in Canberra were always empty at that hour. There was nothing in the way of public transport and taxis were rarer than hen’s teeth – New York City this was not! So it felt heaven sent when I eventually saw a taxi approach, light on to signal it was available.
I flagged the taxi down and asked for a ride home, explaining that I’d call a tow truck and come back for my car in the morning. He had another idea – and offered to change my tyre for me.

So in the middle of a freezing winter’s night, this cheerful, older taxi driver hopped out to change my tyre. He waited to see me drive off safely before leaving and refused my offer of payment for helping. I believe his words were: “Don’t be ridiculous, love!”

articles.title: A Deep Dive Into Hailey Bieber’s Many, Many Face Masks
articles.summary: From cult K-beauty treatments to depuffing creams, collagen wraps, and LED light therapy, Rhode founder Hailey Bieber takes her masking seriously.
body: “Dealing with my issues one mask a time,” wrote Hailey Bieber beneath a recent Instagram carousel. While she’s not elaborating on said issues, her extensive collection of face masks have been exposed for every skincare obsessive’s over-analysis. Hailey Bieber has a face mask for every occasion and skin concern, it seems.

There she is, covered in mustard-yellow paste, slathered in a thick white cream, encased in a glossy lavender-grey treatment, and illuminated by the electric-blue glow of an LED device. There are hydrogel sheets, eye patches, and a rather arresting cobalt-blue mask from a recent trip to Seoul. Bieber is clearly not afraid to cast the net wide in pursuit of good skin.

As she’s previously explained, her approach when her skin is irritated is minimal: rinsing with water, using prescribed azelaic acid and clindamycin, hypochlorous acid, and Rhode’s ceramide-rich Glazing Milk. In her 2025 Beauty Secrets video, she also revealed that she generally skips a full morning cleanse in favor of a water rinse, saving the heavier-duty moisturizing for nighttime.
points: From cult K-beauty treatments to depuffing creams, collagen wraps, and LED light therapy, Rhode founder Hailey Bieber takes her masking seriously.

articles.title: Why Some Flights Were Exempt From the Ground Stop
articles.summary: Dozens of international flights departed from the United States during Friday’s nationwide ground stop. Some planes also left for Hawaii from the West Coast.
body: Thousands of passengers scrambled to update their travel plans on Saturday as air traffic slowly unsnarled after a nationwide ground stop on Friday, but a number of travelers had already arrived at their destinations on flights left unaffected by the order.

Dozens of international flights took to the skies even as airports across the United States coped with only the third nationwide ground stop issued by the Federal Aviation Administration this century. Certain flights were also permitted to depart from the West Coast to Hawaii during the stoppage.
Here’s why some air travel was allowed to proceed even as flight systems were hampered.
More than 8,200 flights were canceled nationwide on Friday — over 31 percent of those scheduled — according to Cirium, an aviation data firm.

articles.title: On the Hunt for Hair-Matching Earmuffs à la Hunter Schafer
articles.summary: “Blade Runner: 2099” star Hunter Schafer donned a pair of sci-fi heroine-coded earmuffs—some winter headgear you can expect to see everywhere.
body: This winter, fashion’s most adventurous heads are getting a little more imaginative with their cold-weather accessories—and Hunter Schafer has made her statement headgear a part of her excellent press tour fashions.

The actor, currently promoting her forthcoming sci-fi series Blade Runner 2099, has been having plenty of fun with the futuristic, otherworldly aesthetic of the franchise. For a recent press junket, she and stylist Dara dipped into the archives for a look from Undercover’s fall 2007 collection: a ribbed, patchwork knit with tiny cable-knit shorts, gray thigh-high socks, and a pair of fuzzy blonde-brown earmuffs that matched her hair.

It was Hunter’s hair that really compounded the look. Hairstylist Rena Calhoun brushed her long, honey-blonde lengths back from her face and divided them into two low ponytails, secured just beneath the oversized, circular earmuffs. The warm brown faux-fur effect blended into her hair and the earthy tones of her knitwear, giving the impression of two enormous, furry ears growing out from either side of her head. Makeup artist Sandy Ganzer kept the beauty minimal, with softly defined eyes, rosy cheeks, and a muted pink lip.

articles.title: Katy Perry and Justin Trudeau Have Their Red Carpet Couple Style on Lock
articles.summary: Last night, the singer and former Canadian prime minister stepped out for the 2026 Baby2Baby Gala, proving they’re found their red carpet rhythm together.
body: Katy Perry and Justin Trudeau may have, at first, seemed like an unlikely pairing, but they have their red carpet style as a couple down to a fine art. The pop star and former Canadian prime minister are becoming regular fixtures on the event circuit, and while their respective wardrobes might come from very different worlds, they’ve found a winning formula: classic suits and tailoring for Trudeau, and a willingness to let Perry’s more maximalist fashion do the talking.

Last night, the couple attended the annual Baby2Baby Gala in Los Angeles. Perry wore a look from Antonio Grimaldi’s spring 2025 couture collection; she donned a strapless, silver sequined minidress layered over a floor-length champagne satin skirt, with a dramatic, sweeping cape falling from the back. She paired it with nude Paris Texas sandals, glittering earrings, and a sleek, flicked-out black bob. Trudeau, meanwhile, looked every inch her date in a white tuxedo jacket with satin lapels, black trousers, and a black bow tie.
points: Last night, the singer and former Canadian prime minister stepped out for the 2026 Baby2Baby Gala, proving they’re found their red carpet rhythm together.

articles.title: Use Humor to Defuse Awkward Moments
articles.summary: If you can laugh at yourself, other people will feel more at ease around you, experts say.
body: Recently, running late for my train to work, I bolted from the house without using my hair-in-a-can. That’s the sprayable hair color I use between dye jobs.

I arrived at the office with snow-white tufts on my temples. Rather than trying to avoid my co-workers, I thought back to a study I’d read about earlier this year. Researchers had found that when someone made a harmless misstep in public, and then laughed at their own blunder, others saw them as warmer and more authentic.
So when I made it to work, I set the tone right away by announcing that I was aware of my temple tufts and of my resemblance to Paulie Walnuts of “The Sopranos.”

“When you can laugh at yourself, that signals that you have some self-acceptance,” said Ovul Sezer Peck, an assistant professor of management and organizations at Cornell University and an author of that study, which was published in The Journal of Personality and Social Psychology. “You’re showing people that you’re comfortable with yourself and your imperfections, which makes you more relatable.”
points: If you can laugh at yourself, other people will feel more at ease around you, experts say.

You can take it up a notch and add in some caramelized onions, jam, or nuts to take the flavors to the next level. articles.title: ‘I Love Being a Girl’: Inside the Life of a Sorority Influencer
articles.summary: Many young adults want to be influencers. And why not? It’s fun. But it also means that the camera is always on.
body: The Alpha Phi sorority house at the University of Arizona occupies a professionally decorated Spanish colonial-style mansion just off campus. There’s a chandeliered dining room, two pink-and-baby-blue living rooms and a tanning area on the roof.

It’s where Haley DeKreek, a 20-year-old junior, lives with her closest friends. It’s also the backdrop to her budding career. Her work takes place mostly in her room, but she picks up the rewards in the mailroom just off the foyer.

Perpetually suffused with floral perfume, it overflows with packages, many of them hers: boxes with dresses for formals or matching yoga sets, boxes of makeup, hair products and skin care. Some she ordered herself, but many are freebies from brands that have spotted her potential as a TikTok influencer, a one-girl campus marketing powerhouse. Nearly all are destined to appear in the many-stepped “get ready with me” videos she has posted since she was a first-year student rushing sororities.
points: But it also means that the camera is always on.

articles.title: The Popular Cutting Board That Replaced My Old Plastic Ones Is on Early Sale for Black Friday
articles.summary: It’s a best-seller for a reason. READ MORE...
body: One of the quiet MVPs of my kitchen is the humble cutting board. They are so necessary for me that I have seven — in different shapes and sizes, no less. Most of them are plastic, though. In the last few months, I’ve been trying to move away from plastic in my kitchen due to the potentially hazardous effects microplastics could have on our bodies (shoutout to our Senior Lifestyle Editor Quinn Fish for putting me on to this).

Naturally, I’ve been looking for plastic-free alternatives, and while I love my paper composite Epicurean boards, I’ve also become a major fan of Material’s The MK Free Board. The plant-based cutting board is huge, making it perfect for meal prepping, family dinners, and big baking projects. I’ve only been using it for a couple weeks, but now I don’t want to be without it!

Material is known for its stylish (and useful) kitchenware, like knives, cooking utensils, tableware, nonstick pans, and more. I’ve been a big fan of the brand’s reBoard, which is a beautiful BPA-free plastic- and sugarcane-based cutting board that has sold out 10 times (unsurprisingly, it’s currently out of stock).

articles.title: I Tried the Best Under-Sink Organizer on Pinterest — And It Lives Up to the Hype (It’s on Major Sale)
articles.summary: Organization is not my strong suit. Case in point: The under-sink cabinets in my kitchen. They are so jumbled and cluttered, they are nerve-wrecking to open (what might come clattering to the floor this time?). In an effort to get these cabinets at least somewhat organized, I turned to Pinterest.
body: You see, one of the top kitchen organization search terms on Pinterest is “ under-sink drawer kitchen organization.” All the photos showcase some of the most pristine, clutter-free cabinets I’ve ever seen. Scrolling through is how I discovered the Delamu 2-Tier Under-Sink Organizer Set. It came up multiple times in my search, with one user even dubbing it one of the “BEST” under-sink organizers for the kitchen.

Started in 2012, organization brand Delamu has all sorts of products to help you keep your home mess-free, including pantry and fridge organizers, a shower caddy, and more. Delamu’s 2-Tier Under-Sink Organizer Set is the first product I’ve ever purchased from the brand, and I found it really easy to put together and install.

This set comes with two organizers, one that’s a smidge over 9 inches and another that’s about 1.5 inch taller (that’s basically the height of a Windex bottle ). They both come unassembled, and putting them together took me about five minutes. They’re also very light at just under 2.5 pounds each without anything in them, so they weren’t difficult to maneuver.

articles.title: 44 Best Wedding Guest Dresses in 2026 for Every Type of Ceremony
articles.summary: Shop the best wedding guest dresses for every kind of ceremony and dress code—from a garden wedding to a beach wedding and courthouse ceremony.
body: Once you’ve coordinated your wedding guest schedule, the next step is figuring out what to wear to all those nuptials. Between decoding dress codes (just how casual is a “casual” wedding, really?) and navigating different climates, you’ll quickly realize there’s no one-size-fits-all solution to this sort of occasion styling. So if you find yourself in the run-up to a fancy affair with a closet full of not-quite-right frocks and a looming deadline—don’t panic. We pulled together an edit of the best wedding guest dresses to suit every possible style, venue, and budget.
Whatever’s in the cards (we mean this literally—please read the invite carefully), our picks for the best wedding guest dresses cover a lot of ground.

The coldest days of the year come with the quandary of formal dressing for freezing temps (is there anything worse than having to cover a great dress with a puffer coat?). Stay warm in Staud’s long-sleeve maxi or a velvet option by Veronica Beard. Or, fully embrace winter glam in Simkhai’s halterneck gown, which has a low back for some drama.
